status_note: RuleSubCommute INT_SDIV/INT_SREM arm port (ticket RULEACTION-SUBCOMMUTE-SDIV-SEXT16-0001, the gap KUNASDIV proved bilaterally: Rugra deferred the arm so the 16-byte signed-division idiom never commuted and never folded — g_div 100/-7 oracle 0xfffffffffffffff2 vs Rugra SUB168(SEXT816(100)/SEXT816(-7),0)). applyOp driven directly on synthetic SUBPIECE(SDIV/SREM16(SEXT..),0) forms; after the single SubCommute application a bounded RulePropagateCopy + RuleSubCancel(SUBPIECE-gated) + RuleCollapseConstants fixpoint reproduces the oppool folding chain. 16 normal cases: both-SEXT written (constant and register ext inputs), positive/negative divisors, SEXT4->16 / SEXT8->16 / SEXT4->8 width boundaries, constant-divisor sign-fit (fit / sign-mismatch / high-bits reject), offset!=0, in0 ZEXT reject, in1 COPY reject, in1 register-input reject, cancelExtensions equal-size / unequal-size (shortenExtension) / constant-ext-isFree guard, SREM mirrors. Trap modes (trap_sdiv/trap_srem, INT64_MIN / -1) record crash forms only: oracle SIGFPE rc 136 with 0-byte stdout vs Rugra panic rc 101 (opbehavior.rs:195 / :212), KUNAUB-SDIV-0001 ruling (a) — no golden.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: applyOp(op,data) mutates the IR by reference; cancelExtensions(longform,subOp,ext0In,ext1In,data) takes ext inputs by value as REBINDABLE locals (ruleaction.cc:4498/4504 overwrite ext0In/ext1In with shortenExtension's return), opUnsetOutput(longform)+newUniqueOut(maxSize)+three opSetInput rewires, SUBPIECE left intact; shortenExtension(extOp,maxSize,data) unsets the extension's output and re-creates it smaller at the same space/address (big-endian bumps offset by size diff, cc:4468-4469).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: arm condition order fixed: offset==0 -> in(0) written -> def is INT_SEXT -> in(1) written (def INT_SEXT -> either ext-input size > outvn -> cancelExtensions partial path) / in(1) constant (sext0In size <= outvn AND sign_extend(val & mask(outvn), outvn, insize) == val) / else reject (cc:4570-4602); generic commute tail iterates longform inputs in slot order with j=-1 for SDIV/SREM (cc:4633-4649); harness iterates ops in SeqNum order and applies RuleSubCancel only to SUBPIECE ops (getOpList gate, ruleaction.cc:5116).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lens: no counters; insize = base->getSize() read once before the arm dispatch (cc:4519/4522) and reused by the constant sign-fit check sign_extend(smallval, outvn->getSize(), insize); the harness pass counter is bounded at 8 with early exit on a no-change pass (both sides identical).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: size comparisons are numeric get_size() ==/</>; loneDescend identity is pointer equality (Arc::ptr_eq in Rust); the constant sign-fit comparison val != smallval is uintb-wide bit equality where smallval = sign_extend(val & calc_mask(outvn), outvn, insize) (address.cc:666, clamped to 8 bytes per side); isFree = !(INPUT|WRITTEN) flags so constants are free (varnode.cc:578) — observable in the sdiv_partial_const_ext case (sub_apply=0 both sides).
